metadata.question: Did regions of the Pacific Northwest like Dallasport, Washington and Medford, Oregon reach temperatures above 105 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: The question is asking if regions in the Pacific Northwest (specifically Dallasport, Washington and Medford, Oregon) reached temperatures above 105°F. For temperature analysis, I should use: - ERA5-Land hourly data (which has temperature_2m band in Kelvin) - Convert from Kelvin to Fahrenheit: °F = (K - 273.15) × 9/5 + 32 - Look for maximum temperatures above 105°F Since this is about extreme temperatures, I should check recent years when heatwaves occurred in the Pacific Northwest (like 2021 heat dome). Let me use 2020-2023 period. Strategy: 1. Define points for both locations 2. Get ERA5-Land temperature data 3. Convert to Fahrenheit and find maximum temperatures 4. Check if any temperatures exceeded 105°F 5. Handle cases where data might be missing Data Quality considerations: - Check if collection is empty (try fallback if needed) - Check if we get valid temperature values - Ensure temperature conversion is correct ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define locations const dallasport = ee.Geometry.Point([-123.7, 46.3]); // Dallasport, WA approximate coordinates const medford = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.9, 42.3]); // Medford, OR approximate coordinates const regions = ee.FeatureCollection([ee.Feature(dallasport, {name: 'Dallasport'}), ee.Feature(medford, {name: 'Medford'})]); // Time period - focusing on recent years with known heatwaves const startDate = '2020-01-01'; const endDate = '2023-12-31'; // Get ERA5-Land temperature data const tempCollection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('temperature_2m'); // Check collection size const collectionSize = tempCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`ERA5 Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Convert temperature from Kelvin to Fahrenheit and find max const maxTempF = tempCollection.map(function(image) { const tempK = image.select('temperature_2m'); const tempF = tempK.subtract(273.15).multiply(9/5).add(32); return tempF.rename('temperature_2m_f'); }).max(); // Calculate max temperature for each location const dallasportMax = maxTempF.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: dallasport, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m_f'); const medfordMax = maxTempF.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: medford, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m_f'); // Get values const dallasportVal = dallasportMax.getInfo(); const medfordVal = medfordMax.getInfo(); console.log(`Dallasport Max Temp: ${dallasportVal ? dallasportVal.toFixed(1) : 'N/A'}°F`); console.log(`Medford Max Temp: ${medfordVal ? medfordVal.toFixed(1) : 'N/A'}°F`); // Validation checks if (dallasportVal === null || medfordVal === null || isNaN(dallasportVal) || isNaN(medfordVal)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if either location exceeded 105°F const dallasportAbove105 = dallasportVal > 105; const medfordAbove105 = medfordVal > 105; console.log(`Dallasport >105°F: ${dallasportAbove105}`); console.log(`Medford >105°F: ${medfordAbove105}`); // Final answer if (dallasportAbove105 || medfordAbove105) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
